title: Builder Signals · 2026-07-17
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 40 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 13 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini VP
featured.summaryEn: Josh Woodward announced Gemini Spark's expansion: rolling out to more Ultra subscribers, now able to open and edit Google Docs, read comments in Sheets and Slides, and running 50%+ faster. He also released the first-ever Gemini Southeast Asia Report with three insights—active users more than doubled in a year, 70% of prompts are in native languages, and 40% use only voice, image, or video. It confirms a trend: non-English, multimodal input is becoming the default in emerging markets, not an edge case.
featured.insightZh: Josh Woodward 公布了 Gemini Spark 的扩量与更新：面向更多 Ultra 订阅用户开放，新增能打开并编辑 Google Docs、读取 Sheets 和 Slides 里的评论、整体提速 50% 以上。他还发布了首份《Gemini 东南亚报告》，三个数据点值得关注——活跃用户过去一年翻倍多，70% 的 prompt 用母语提交，40% 的 prompt 只用语音、图片或视频。这印证了一个趋势：非英语、多模态输入正在成为新兴市场 AI 使用的默认形态，而不是边角料。

featured.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
featured.summaryEn: Boris Cherny shared a thought on where engineering value is shifting: the best engineers he knew always spent lots of time automating their own work—better vim/emacs setups, writing lint rules to catch repeat issues, building e2e test suites to avoid manual smoke tests. That "automation-as-engineering" instinct is exactly what makes someone great at squeezing the most out of agents. People who automate naturally know how to scaffold for an agent.
featured.insightZh: Boris Cherny 抛出一个关于工程师价值转移的观察：过去他认识的最好的工程师都花大量时间自动化自己的工作——更好的 vim/emacs 配置、写 lint 规则抓重复问题、搭 e2e 测试套件省去手工冒烟。这个"自动化即工程"的本能，在 AI coding 时代正好是能把 agent 用到极致的人的核心素质。会自动化的人天然懂怎么给 agent 搭脚手架。

featured.title: Granola 创始人 Chris 谈第一波 AI 应用之后是什么
featured.summaryEn: Meeting notes are just the starting point—the real fight is reinventing the interface for "humans working with AI." Work is bifurcating into async multiplayer collaboration in Slack, and deep human-agent same-screen collaboration in Codex/Claude. Dan Shipper talks with Chris, founder of the $1.5B Granola. Chris opens by breaking the "success myth": startups are knife fights, hard when things aren't working and just as hard when they are—you're always on a surfboard at the edge of your abilities, trying not to get pounded. Facing Notion, OpenAI, and Zoom all copying meeting notes, he's calm: meeting notes were never the end-all value; the real opportunity is reinventing "how we work and what interface we use" in an AI-native world. Who's fighting over what today doesn't matter—the huge opportunity ahead does. On team organization, both Chris and Dan are feeling out roles for the AI era.…
featured.insightZh: 会议笔记只是起点，真正的仗是重新发明"人和 AI 一起工作"的界面——工作正在分叉成 Slack 里的异步多人协作，和 Codex/Claude 里人机同屏的深度协作两个面。 Dan Shipper 对话估值 15 亿美元的 Granola 创始人 Chris。开场 Chris 就打破"成功神话"：创业是"刀战"，不顺时难，顺的时候一样难——你永远站在能力边缘的冲浪板上，努力不被大浪拍下去。面对 Notion、OpenAI、Zoom 纷纷抄会议笔记，他反而淡定：会议笔记从来不是终局价值，真正的机会是重新发明 AI 原生世界里"我们怎么工作、用什么界面工作"。谁在今天争什么不重要，前方那个巨大的机会才重要。 在团队组织上，Chris 和 Dan 都在摸索 AI 时代的角色划分。Dan 提出一个"海盗 + 建筑师"模型：海盗负责极速 vibe code 找到有价值的东西（技术、产品、设计合一），建筑师负责把海盗的发现变成可持续、可扩展的系统——一个海盗配一个产品，但一个建筑师能在多个产品间穿梭，因为如今的工具好到能让好的架构师一小时内摸清一个陌生代码库、丢给 Codex 做 24 小时重写。Granola 则借鉴 Basecamp 的 Shape Up，用"塑形→验证→打磨"三阶段推进新功能，但两人都承认 PM/设计/工程的传统角色边界正在失效，"也许有一天全是 agent"。 最有洞见的是 Chris 和 Dan 对未来产品形态的推演。Dan 判断工作正在分叉成两个面：一是 Slack 里的异步委派——多人、有时主动，像和同事协作，每天早上 bot 汇报修了哪些 bug、推了哪些 PR，你可以直接让它去开 PR 或给新产品起名，全程公开进行（因为大多数 AI 现在是单人的，公开反而促进同侪学习）；二是 Codex/Claude 桌面端的人机同屏深度协作。Dan 已经把邮件、换网络运营商这类杂事都丢给 Codex 的 in-app 浏览器处理——它自己登录 Verizon 网站、和客服 AI 对话、算清有没有隐藏费用，把宽带套餐换好。他提出「Codex 原生 app」概念…

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini VP
items.summaryEn: Josh Woodward announced Gemini Spark's expansion: rolling out to more Ultra subscribers, now able to open and edit Google Docs, read comments in Sheets and Slides, and running 50%+ faster. items.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
items.summaryEn: Boris Cherny shared a thought on where engineering value is shifting: the best engineers he knew always spent lots of time automating their own work—better vim/emacs setups, writing lint rules to catch repeat issues, building e2e test suites to avoid manual smoke tests. That "automation-as-engineering" instinct is exactly what makes someone great at squeezing the most out of agents. People who automate naturally know how to scaffold for an agent.
items.insightZh: Boris Cherny 抛出一个关于工程师价值转移的观察：过去他认识的最好的工程师都花大量时间自动化自己的工作——更好的 vim/emacs 配置、写 lint 规则抓重复问题、搭 e2e 测试套件省去手工冒烟。这个"自动化即工程"的本能，在 AI coding 时代正好是能把 agent 用到极致的人的核心素质。会自动化的人天然懂怎么给 agent 搭脚手架。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
items.summaryEn: Thariq offered a crisp prompting principle: the ideal technique is "thin prompts + thick artifacts/context + thin skills." Don't cram all the logic into the prompt—put the weight into reusable context artifacts and durable skill files, keep the prompt light. He added a line that cuts to the core: software engineering is "the profession of automation"—echoing Boris's observation.
items.insightZh: Thariq 给出一个很凝练的 prompting 心法：理想的做法是「薄 prompt + 厚 artifact 和 context + 薄 skills」。换句话说，别把逻辑全塞进 prompt，而是把重量放在可复用的上下文产物和沉淀的 skill 文件里，prompt 本身保持轻。他还补了一句抓本质的话：软件工程本质就是"自动化这门职业"——和 Boris 的观察遥相呼应。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux shared two Codex updates: first, the 5-hour usage limit has been removed from Codex Plus and Pro for a few days, and he's collecting feedback on whether weekly limits work better. Second, he candidly disclosed investigating reports of GPT-5.6 unexpectedly deleting files—most common when full access mode is on without sandboxing and without auto review enabled. A clear safety note for enterprises: keep review and sandbox guardrails when giving a coding agent full access.
items.insightZh: Thibault Sottiaux 透露了两条 Codex 产品动向：其一，Codex Plus 和 Pro 已经取消了 5 小时使用限制几天了，他在收集用户反馈——按周限额是否更好用。其二，他坦诚披露并调查了 GPT-5.6 意外删文件的少数报告，发现最常见于「开启 full access 模式且没有沙箱保护、也没开 auto review」的组合下。对企业用户是明确的安全提示：给 coding agent 全权限时务必保留 review 和沙箱这两道闸。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang pointed out an obvious product split at OpenAI: ChatGPT Live and Codex are both excellent, yet they don't talk to each other. On a walk, he asked ChatGPT Live to pull up his Google Doc and got refused—he had to manually trigger the Documents plugin. In his view this is OpenAI's biggest missed opportunity: two flagship products with no connective tissue, a user experience artificially fragmented. This "product island" problem is the real-world flip side of the "bring your agent to every app" thesis discu…
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 指出 OpenAI 一个明显的产品割裂：ChatGPT Live 和 Codex 是两个都很出色的产品，却互相不通。他实测在散步时用 ChatGPT Live 让它调出自己的 Google Doc，被拒绝；只能手动触发 Documents 插件才行。在他看来这是 OpenAI 最大的错失机会——两个明星产品之间缺少打通，用户体验被人为割裂。这类"产品孤岛"问题，恰是同期播客里 Granola 创始人聊到的"把 agent 带进各个 app"命题的现实反面。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie shared notes from a dinner with large-enterprise IT leaders on agent adoption. Key takeaways: change management remains one of the biggest topics for workflow transformation—most processes need to be upgraded to modern operations before agents can truly land. He's also bullish on open-weights momentum (especially from a US lab), predicting AI's future is a hybrid of "frontier intelligence as orchestrator + lower-cost or tuned models as the workhorse"—a pragmatic signal for enterprise cost and complianc…
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 分享了一场与大型企业 IT 负责人的晚宴笔记，聚焦企业里的 agent 采纳。核心观点：变更管理仍是推动工作流转型的最大议题之一，大多数流程需要先升级到现代化操作方式，agent 才能真正落地。他还看好开源权重模型（尤其来自美国实验室）的势头，判断 AI 的未来是「前沿智能做编排 + 更低成本或调优模型做主力活」的混合架构——这对企业成本与合规都是务实信号。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Guillermo Rauch showed Vercel Sandbox growth: DAUs growing 100% month-over-month, 3.5M+ sandboxes created per day, already powering Notion, Airtable, Meta, Zapier and more. He also demoed the Web Analytics API—having an agent correlate visitors and custom events (purchase, checkout) with deployment evolution and performance, or build custom frontends alongside Stripe and Resend data. For teams building agent infrastructure, it signals that "sandboxed execution + observability" is becoming table stakes.
items.insightZh: Guillermo Rauch 晒了 Vercel Sandbox 的增长数据：DAU 月环比 100% 增长，每天创建超 350 万个 sandbox，并已支撑 Notion、Airtable、Meta、Zapier 等一批客户。他同时展示了 Web Analytics API 的用法——让 agent 把访客、自定义事件（如 purchase、checkout）与部署演进和性能关联分析，或搭配 Stripe、Resend 的数据构建自定义前端。对做 agent 基础设施的团队，这是一个"沙箱执行 + 可观测性"正在成为标配的信号。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator 总裁兼 CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan reshared and endorsed an emerging thesis: skill files are portable and free you from frontier-model dependency—"this is a good thing." It lands on a key point in today's AI engineering: when capabilities are captured as standardized, portable skill files, teams are no longer locked to a single model vendor and can switch the underlying model freely. It resonates within the same week as Thariq's "thin skills" and Aaron Levie's "hybrid model architecture."
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 转发并背书了一个正在成型的趋势判断：skill 文件是可移植的，能把你从对特定前沿模型的依赖中解放出来——「这是件好事」。这句话点在了当下 AI 工程的关键处：当能力沉淀为标准化、可迁移的 skill 文件，团队就不再被单一模型供应商锁死，可以灵活切换底层模型。这和 Thariq「薄 skills」、Aaron Levie「混合模型架构」的观点形成了同一周的共振。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder / Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang offered a sharp observation on org design: to make agents actually work inside a company, you have to design the company so they can read it. She cited Shopify—they deployed an agent with no private chat function at all, only public channels, with the side effect of driving peer learning. It touches a deeper thesis: a company's information architecture in the AI era (public vs private, searchable vs buried) directly determines how much value agents can deliver—the same idea as "design the company to be…
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 提出一个关于组织设计的犀利观察：想让 agent 在公司里真正干活，你得把公司设计成 agent 能"读得懂"的样子。她举 Shopify 为例——他们上线的一个 agent 完全没有私聊功能，只能在公开频道运作，副作用是促进了同侪学习。这触及一个深层命题：AI 时代的公司信息架构（公开 vs 私密、可检索 vs 埋没）直接决定 agent 能发挥多大价值，和播客里"设计公司让 agent 可读"是同一思路。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 贡献者
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger quoted and reinforced an argument on "automation as responsibility": if you submit a PR to an unfamiliar iOS codebase and a reviewer rejects it for "not using the right framework," or a designer's new feature is rejected for "not following architectural patterns"—these are fundamentally failures of automation, not of people. The point: constraints and conventions should be baked into tooling and lint to run automatically; relying on human review to catch them means the automation fell short. He a…
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger 引用并强化了一个关于"自动化即职责"的论点：如果你给一个不熟悉的 iOS 代码库提 PR，被 reviewer 以"没用对框架"驳回；或设计师做的新功能因"不符合架构模式"被拒——这些本质上都是"自动化的失败"，而不是人的失败。意思是：约束和规范本该被固化进工具和 lint 里自动执行，靠人肉 review 兜底说明自动化没做到位。他还评价 GPT-5.6"relentless（不知疲倦地推进）"。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监（前 Google Gemini/Veo/Nano Banana）
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru coined a term for an emerging phenomenon: the moment you read something and realize it's AI-written, the brain first recoils, followed by a mix of disgust and mental nausea. He names it "semantic nausea" or "uncanny prose." He also shared his fix: consciously using AI mainly in the brainstorming phase now, keeping the final writing human. For anyone producing lots of AI-generated content, it's a sober reminder of how the "AI smell" can undermine credibility.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 为一个新兴现象造了个词：读到一段文字、意识到它是 AI 写的那一刻，大脑先是本能回缩，接着涌上一种混合了厌恶和精神反胃的感觉。他给这种感觉起名叫「semantic nausea（语义性反胃）」或「uncanny prose（诡异文风）」。他还分享了自己的应对：现在有意识地只在头脑风暴阶段用 AI，最终成稿保持"人写"。对所有大量用 AI 产出内容的人，这是一个关于"AI 味"如何反噬可信度的清醒提醒。

items.title: Claude Code 现已支持 Artifacts
items.summaryEn: Anthropic announced artifacts in Claude Code: turn a session's work progress into shareable, live visual pages—PR walkthroughs, system explainers, dashboards, release checklists—that update themselves as the session works. The key is that an artifact is built on the full context of your session (codebase, connectors, the conversation itself); you don't wire up data sources or stand up infrastructure—you ask for a page and Claude Code builds it from what already exists. Every publish is a new version at the same link, with version history for restore, and a gallery to manage them all. The most common internal use case is debugging: an engineer kicks off an incident investigation before standup, Claude Code works through logs and publishes an artifact—a timeline, suspect commits, an error-rate chart—shared to the team from the page header; by standup it's been republished twice as the inv…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude Code 新增 artifacts 能力：把一次会话的工作进展直接变成可分享的实时可视化网页——PR 走查、系统讲解、仪表盘、发布清单等，会随着会话推进自动更新。关键点在于 artifact 基于会话的完整上下文构建（代码库、连接器、对话本身），你不需要接数据源或搭基础设施，只要开口要一个页面，Claude Code 就从已有信息里生成。每次发布都是同一链接上的新版本，有版本历史可随时回滚，还有画廊统一管理。 内部测试中最常见的用例是调试：工程师在站会前发起事故调查，Claude Code 梳理日志后发布一个 artifact——时间线、可疑 commit、错误率曲线，从页头直接分享给团队；等站会开始时它已经随调查进展重新发布过两次。好处是团队成员和干系人不用再让人"讲一遍 agent 发现了什么"，大家看的是同一个带完整上下文的视图。官方还按角色给了用法示例（法务查依赖许可证、隐私追踪个人数据流向、安全把发现链接到具体代码行、SRE 把事故页养成事后复盘）。默认对作者私有，仅组织内认证成员可见，不能公开；目前对 Claude Team 和 Enterprise 组织 beta 开放。
